# Paul Irving

## Overview

- **Age:** Thirteen years old
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c28 P23](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0023)</sub>
- **Origin:** Boston, United States  <sub>[v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolboy

## Appearance

Paul is physically characterized by his refined features, brown curls, and dreamy, dark blue eyes. He is a small, quiet, and fair-minded boy who grows noticeably bigger, brown, and sturdy over time.

_Sources: [v2 c28 P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022), [v2 c28 P27](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0027)_

## Personality

Paul is a sensitive, highly imaginative, and poetic child who possesses deep, uncanny insight and a talent for creative storytelling. He is polite, gentlemanly, and respectful, though he remains sensitive to authority and cares deeply about how others perceive him. While thoughtful and meditative, he is also manly, fair-minded, and capable of holding his own in games or standing up for his beliefs.

_Sources: [v2 c11 P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041)_

## Traits

- Highly imaginative
- Sensitive
- Gentlemanly and polite
- Manly and fair-minded
- Dislikes being surprised  <sub>[v2 c28 P26](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0026)</sub>

## Abilities

- Talented storyteller and writer  <sub>[v2 c11 P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041), [v2 c11 P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 c11 P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043), [v2 c11 P44](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0044)</sub>
- Capable in games and sports

## Goals

- To be understood by sympathetic, imaginative people  <sub>[v2 c11 P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041)</sub>

## History

After moving to Avonlea to live with his grandmother, Paul attends the local school, where he quickly forms a deep bond with his teacher, Anne Shirley. Anne considers him a genius and one of her most beloved pupils, sharing a unique imaginative connection with him. At school, Paul behaves as a model student and gentleman, though he once fought St. Clair Donnell in defense of the Stars and Stripes, resulting in a drawn battle and mutual respect. During Anne's tenure, Paul shares his imaginative tales of his 'rock people' with her and introduces her to his world of fancy. Through Anne, his presence leads to a reunion between his father, Stephen Irving, and Miss Lavendar Lewis, culminating in their marriage. Paul eventually prepares to leave Avonlea to live in Boston with his father and new stepmother, Miss Lavendar.

_Sources: [v2 c11 P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041), [v2 c21 P81](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0081), [v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083), [v2 c28 P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021), [v2 c28 P23](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0023), [v2 c28 P30](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0030)_

## Background by volume

- Born to Stephen Irving and his late wife
- Moved from Boston to Avonlea to live with his grandmother along the shore road  <sub>[v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083)</sub>
- Created an elaborate imaginative world populated by his 'rock people'  <sub>[v2 c11 P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041), [v2 c11 P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 c11 P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043), [v2 c11 P44](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0044)</sub>

## Quotes
